title: Reading Drill — Keeping a music room cool — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping a music room cool — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The building caretaker had been asked to investigate instruments warming unevenly in a rehearsal room in Millcross. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on temperature variation across stands, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a four-week comparison, the team used portable sensors at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because the number of people rehearsing might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a rearranged storage area. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
